title: Embeddings microtier + burst-credit pricing experiment for rerank economics
creator: Asha Patel
description: Run a two-arm pricing pilot that tests a "microtier" per-vector unit (smaller unit granularity than existing per-vector price) combined with a burst-credit top-up model for reranking-heavy workloads. Goal: surface price elasticity for high-frequency rerank requests, reduce sticker shock for low-volume customers, and measure how burst credits change spike costs for Dedicated/Private customers. This ticket covers product definition, telemetry, contract/QSA language edits, experiment ramp plan, billing prototype, and rollout criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry capturing effective USD per 1000 vectors and per-rerank-request across pilot cohorts
Two cohorts live for >=14 days with >=50k vectors processed each
Clear elastic demand curve (price vs volume) produced and reviewed by Finance
Contract sample language drafted for enterprise QSA and billing terms and approved by Legal
Billing prototype integrated with usage pipeline and simulated invoices validated against expected math
decisions: Use a microtier size of 10 vectors as the smallest billable unit for pilot cohort A
Pilot cohort B will use existing per-vector billing + 1000 burst credits per month to evaluate churn/usage changes
Burst credits are non-refundable and expire after 30 days for the pilot
Default fallback: if telemetry shows >15% revenue loss vs baseline, pause cohort enrollment and revert pricing for new signups
